sources.entry: Enigma 1/2 BBS - Enigma 1/2 is a modern, multi-platform BBS engine with unlimited "callers" and legacy DOS door game support. (Source Code) BSD-2-Clause Shell/Docker/Nodejs

summary.one_liner: ENiGMA½ is a Node.js-based bulletin board system (BBS) engine that supports telnet, SSH, and WebSocket callers, plus legacy DOS and Amiga door games.
summary.what_it_does: ENiGMA½ runs a classic BBS with telnet, SSH, and secure and non-secure WebSocket access, and a built-in web server for temporary download URLs and file browsing. It stores users and message areas in SQLite and uses PBKDF2 password hashing with optional TOTP two-factor login. Message networks are supported through native FidoNet (FTN) BinkP/1.1 mailer code and MRC, and internet email can be sent and received via IMAP/SMTP from the private message system. Legacy doors can run through built-in v86 x86/DOS emulation and an embedded vAmiga (WebAssembly) Amiga emulator, and Z-Machine interactive fiction is supported. Customization is done through HJSON config, menus, themes, and JavaScript mods.
use_cases: run a retro bulletin board system for callers
host classic DOS or Amiga BBS door games
connect a BBS to FidoNet-style message networks
play Infocom Z-Machine interactive fiction over telnet or SSH
share files and file bases with BBS users
operate a BBS with web-based file downloads
how_to_run: curl -o- | bash  (on most *nix systems, per README; the URL is missing from the source text)
See Installation Methods in the docs for Windows, Docker, and other setups
notable: Native BinkP/1.1 FidoNet mailer without an external binkd
Built-in x86/DOS door emulation via v86 with no QEMU or DOSBox needed
Amiga door emulation via embedded vAmiga with bundled AROS ROM
Wide character and CP437/UTF-8 support including CJK
Z-Machine interactive fiction door supporting versions 3, 4, 5, and 8
caveats: Amiga ARexx doors need your own Workbench 3.1 ROM; only AROS is bundled
Windows and other platforms are covered by separate installation methods in the docs rather than the one-line install
